summary: IMC Rare Earths Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 22, 2026, announcing metallurgical testwork results from the University of Brighton for its Itarantim rare earth project in Brazil. The press release reported 73% in-situ rare earth recovery using acidified magnesium sulphate, including 71.4% terbium and 70.5% dysprosium, supporting evaluation of in-situ recovery as a lower-capital development pathway. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors were disclosed; the filing serves solely to inform investors of technical progress.
